metadata.remarks: A deliberately minimal OSCAL system-security-plan whose only purpose is to give the assessment plan in this repository a valid import-ssp target and to show a consumer where their own system description belongs. Replace every placeholder before use. Nothing in this file asserts anything about a real system.

system-characteristics.system-name: PLACEHOLDER — name of the high-risk AI system under assessment
system-characteristics.description: PLACEHOLDER — replace with the system description required by Annex IV(1). This template asserts nothing about any real system.

information-types.title: PLACEHOLDER — information processed by the AI system
information-types.description: PLACEHOLDER — describe the input data categories and any special categories of personal data, per Article 10.

status.remarks: Template. Not a description of an operational system.

authorization-boundary.description: PLACEHOLDER — describe the boundary of the AI system as placed on the market or put into service, including integrated general-purpose AI models and third-party components (Article 25).

components.title: PLACEHOLDER — the high-risk AI system
components.description: PLACEHOLDER — replace with the component under assessment.

control-implementation.description: PLACEHOLDER — one implemented-requirement per control in the imported profile. Two are stubbed to show the shape; a real plan enumerates all of them.

implemented-requirements.remarks: PLACEHOLDER — describe the risk management system and where its documentation lives.
PLACEHOLDER — describe the serious-incident detection and reporting procedure, including the routing that meets the 2-day, 10-day and 15-day deadlines.
